Class FaissMetaIndexBindings

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.vector.faiss.FaissMetaIndexBindings
public final class FaissMetaIndexBindings extends Object
FFM bindings for FAISS MetaIndexes (MetaIndexes_c.h), IndexReplicas (IndexReplicas_c.h), IndexShards (IndexShards_c.h), IndexPreTransform (IndexPreTransform_c.h), and IndexLSH (IndexLSH_c.h).
